facts.fact: The ODPC issued a notice on 28 August 2026 under section 18 of the Data Protection Act, 2019 giving controllers and processors with expired registration certificates until 11 September 2026 to renew or face enforcement, and published the list of such entities on its website.
The Star reports the ODPC enforcing section 18 of the Data Protection Act, 2019, which bars unregistered controllers and processors from acting.
The Star reports the ODPC as the independent oversight body established by the Act and acting, with a registration register and notice of 28 August 2026.
